author: smuzaffar
body:
This PR proposes to remove the explicit `#define EDM_ML_DEBUG` from the `BTLDigiSoAProducer.cc` source file. If it is needed for debugging then one should either use the DBG IBs or locally build with `USER_CXXFLAGS=-DEDM_ML_DEBUG`.

This change should fix the DBG_X warninsg like
https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/buildlogs/el9_amd64_gcc14/CMSSW_20_1_DBG_X_2026-11-18-2300/RecoLocalFastTime/FTLRecProducers
```
src/RecoLocalFastTime/FTLRecProducers/plugins/BTLDigiSoAProducer.cc:1:9: warning: "EDM_ML_DEBUG" redefined
     1 | #define EDM_ML_DEBUG
      |         ^~~~~~~~~~~~
```
title: BTLDigiSoAProducer.cc: Remove explicit EDM_ML_DEBUG definition
